---
name: Feature Request
about: Improvements to FITA
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["feature-request", "needs-triage"]
---
## Summary
Provide a clear and concise description of the desired feature or enhancement.

## Motivation / Use Case
Explain **why this feature is needed** and how it will improve the fita components. Include specific scenarios or problems it solves.

## Proposed Solution (Optional)
If you have ideas on how to implement this, describe them briefly.  
- APIs, CLI commands, or configuration changes  
- Integration with other FITA components  

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternatives or workarounds you considered.  

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, diagrams, or references that may help maintainers understand the request.
